How lashes grow

Understanding the lash growth cycle.

Every lash moves through four natural stages: growth, transition, rest, and shedding. Consistent daily care helps nourish the lash line and support healthier-looking lashes throughout this cycle.

01Anagen
Active growth stage, when the lash is forming and lengthening.
02Catagen
Transition stage, when active growth slows and the follicle begins to rest.
03Telogen
Resting stage, when the mature lash remains in place.
04Exogen
Shedding stage, when the old lash releases and a new cycle begins.

How to use

One clean line,
twice a day.

Apply every morning and evening to clean, dry skin. Use the fine applicator to draw a thin line directly along the upper lash root.

01Cleanse the eye area and make sure the eyelid is completely dry.
02Apply one thin, even line along the upper lash root.
03Allow the serum to absorb before applying other eye products.

Questions

Everything you need to know.

How often should I use it?

Use twice daily. Apply every morning and evening after cleansing for the best results.

When will I see results?

Most users notice visible improvement within 15 days. Some may see changes in as little as 7 days, depending on individual lash growth and absorption.

Who is it for?

Ideal for anyone who wears eyelash extensions, false lashes, or mascara regularly, or experiences weak, brittle, or sparse lashes.

How many bottles should I use?

For optimal results, we recommend completing one full treatment with two bottles.
